chat.text: I reviewed the security and integration gaps and added specific controls, acceptance tests, and six decisions to settle before implementation. The updates cover owner bootstrap, login/recovery and token rotation, offline/local-data policy, SQLite and Android backup exposure, object-level authorization, Sheets OAuth, sync retries/conflicts, and concurrent payment integrity. Please review the new sections and tell me whether you want any of the open decisions handled differently.

Understood: this is an Android APK. I updated the plan so local SQLite is the source of truth, invoice/sale records are saved in-app when issued, and individual plus monthly Excel exports are downloadable from those records. It also notes that shadcn is web-only and adds an open question about whether “Excel code” means receipt IDs, formulas, or both.
